description: Automation + data + docs: create scripts/sync-dance-logos.ts (TypeScript, run via node --experimental-strip-types) that discovers/validates/downloads verified logos to /public/logos/ and upserts dance_orgs via the service role (preserving existing verified assets on failure), add the logos:sync npm script, create the deterministic seed SQL, create the weekly cron route /api/cron/dance-logos, merge the weekly job into vercel.json (keeping dance-agent), and produce LOGO_SOURCES.md and the final report.md. Depends on FEAT-001 (writes the dance_orgs table). Independent of FEAT-002.
steps: Create scripts/sync-dance-logos.ts (TypeScript). Run pattern: node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings (match scripts/seed-dance-updates.ts). Use RELATIVE imports only (no @/ alias): import { createClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js'; node:fs, node:path, node:url; and the base org list from '../lib/dance/constants.ts'. Export a SyncReport type and `export async function runDanceLogoSync(opts?: { writeFiles?: boolean }): Promise<SyncReport>` (reusable core). Add a CLI guard so importing from the cron route does not auto-run: if (process.argv[1]?.replace(/\\/g,'/').endsWith('scripts/sync-dance-logos.ts')) main().catch((e)=>{console.error(e);process.exit(1);}); where main() calls runDanceLogoSync({writeFiles:true}) and prints the summary.

Define the ORGS list in the script (required 7 + researched additions). Each entry: { slug, name, website_url, officialDomains: string[], candidatePaths: string[] }. Required: IDL (https://www.thedancelebague.com), STEEZY (https://www.steezy.com), World of Dance (https://www.worldofdance.com), Hip Hop International (https://www.hiphopinternational.com), Red Bull Dance Your Style (https://www.redbull.com/danceyourstyle), Juste Debout (https://www.justedebout.com), UDO / United Dance Organisation (https://www.udodanceworld.com). Researched international: Battle of the Year (https://www.battleoftheyear.net), WDSF / World DanceSport Federation (https://www.worlddancesport.org). Researched Philippine: research 1-2 reputable PH dance leagues/competitions with an official .ph domain at implementation time; if none can be confirmed, still seed it and mark logo_verified=false with a fallback reason.
Implement per-org discovery in priority order: (1) official press/brand kit page (try candidatePaths), (2) SVG/logo used in the official site header (fetch the homepage HTML, scan ,

Validate each candidate strictly: HTTPS only; HTTP 200 (HEAD, fall back to GET if HEAD unsupported); Content-Type starts with 'image/' (allow image/svg+xml); content length >= 1024 bytes; hostname matches an officialDomain or a known official CDN subdomain (provenance). Then GET the bytes and confirm they are a real image (reject HTML error pages or tracking pixels served as 200). Inspect the actual response — never trust filename or URL. On first valid candidate: download bytes to public/logos/<slug>.<ext> (ext from content-type: .svg/.png/.jpg/.webp), set logo_url='/logos/<slug>.<ext>', logo_source_url=candidate, logo_verified=true. If writeFiles===false OR the file write throws (read-only FS), skip the write, keep any existing logo_url, and still record logo_source_url/logo_verified/updated_at.

On failure: set logo_url=null, logo_verified=false, capture fallbackReason. PRESERVE existing verified assets: query the existing row first; if it already has logo_verified=true and the new candidate fails, do NOT null out logo_url/logo_verified — keep them and only refresh updated_at, logging that the existing asset was preserved.

Upsert dance_orgs using a service-role Supabase client: const supabase = createClient(process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL!, process.env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY!, { auth: { persistSession: false } }); then supabase.from('dance_orgs').upsert({ name, slug, website_url, logo_url, logo_source_url, logo_verified, sort_order, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() }, { onConflict: 'slug' }). Read keys from process.env only; NEVER log them; if SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY is missing, print a clear error and exit non-zero (do not expose the key). sort_order: assign by list index.

Print a summary table at the end: org name | logo file (or TEXT PILL) | source URL | verified (yes/no) | fallback reason. Return a SyncReport object { ok: boolean, results: [...], updated, preserved, fallbackCount } for the cron route to return as JSON.
Add to package.json scripts: "logos:sync": "node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings scripts/sync-dance-logos.ts". Do not change other scripts.

Create supabase/seed_dance_orgs.sql: INSERT INTO dance_orgs (name, slug, website_url, sort_order, logo_verified) VALUES (…) for the SAME ORGS list as the script (logo_url null, logo_verified false), with ON CONFLICT (slug) DO UPDATE SET name = EXCLUDED.name, website_url = EXCLUDED.website_url, sort_order = EXCLUDED.sort_order. Add a SQL comment cross-referencing scripts/sync-dance-logos.ts as the source of truth for logos. This seeds the table so the carousel shows orgs (text-pill fallbacks) even before a network sync runs.

Create app/api/cron/dance-logos/route.ts mirroring app/api/cron/dance-agent/route.ts: export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'; export const maxDuration = 300; (logo sync does many fetches; note this may need Vercel Pro). GET handler checks CRON_SECRET via Authorization Bearer / ?key= / vercel-cron user-agent EXACTLY as dance-agent does, then const report = await runDanceLogoSync({ writeFiles: true }); (import via relative path: import { runDanceLogoSync } from '../../../scripts/sync-dance-logos.ts'; — webpack bundles it; it only uses @supabase/supabase-js + node built-ins + a relative import to constants.ts), and returns NextResponse.json(report, { status: report.ok ? 200 : 500 }). Wrap in try/catch returning 500 on throw.

MERGE vercel.json: keep the existing { "path": "/api/cron/dance-agent", "schedule": "0 */6 * * *" } entry and ADD { "path": "/api/cron/dance-logos", "schedule": "0 3 * * 1" } to the same crons array (weekly, Monday 03:00 UTC). Do NOT remove or overwrite dance-agent. Result must contain BOTH entries.

Create LOGO_SOURCES.md at c:\website\GrooveSystem\LOGO_SOURCES.md: a Markdown table with columns Organization | Official Website | Logo Source URL | Verification Status | Fallback Reason, one row per ORGS entry, populated from the ACTUAL sync run results. If the sync could not run (no creds/network), populate website_url from the ORGS list and mark Verification Status as 'Pending (no network)' with the fallback reason — never claim verified without a real source URL.

Create c:\website\GrooveSystem\.agents\tasks\dance-org-carousel\report.md: the final report — list the orgs using text-pill fallbacks and the reason for each; summarize verification (build output, link/rel correctness, reduced-motion, target/rel, next/image preload). Record actual npm run build output. Never claim an unverified logo is verified.

Verify: cd c:\website\GrooveSystem && npm run typecheck (zero errors); npm run build (zero errors); npm run logos:sync runs and prints the summary (fallbacks acceptable if no network/creds — record actual results in LOGO_SOURCES.md/report.md); vercel.json is valid JSON with BOTH cron entries; LOGO_SOURCES.md and report.md exist with a row for every org.
acceptance_criteria: scripts/sync-dance-logos.ts exists as TypeScript, exports runDanceLogoSync(), uses relative imports (no @/), reads SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY from process.env (never logs it), downloads verified logos to public/logos/<slug>.<ext>, upserts dance_orgs by slug, preserves existing verified assets on failure, and prints a summary table. The CLI guard prevents auto-run on import.
supabase/seed_dance_orgs.sql exists with INSERT … ON CONFLICT (slug) DO UPDATE for the ORGS list (logo_url null, logo_verified false) and a cross-reference comment to the script.

app/api/cron/dance-logos/route.ts exists with dynamic='force-dynamic', maxDuration=300, the CRON_SECRET check mirroring dance-agent, calls runDanceLogoSync({writeFiles:true}) via relative import, returns JSON.
vercel.json is valid JSON and contains BOTH /api/cron/dance-agent and /api/cron/dance-logos (weekly).

LOGO_SOURCES.md exists at the repo root with a row per org (Organization, Official Website, Logo Source URL, Verification Status, Fallback Reason) reflecting actual sync results; no row claims verified without a real source URL.
.agents/tasks/dance-org-carousel/report.md exists listing fallback orgs and reasons plus the actual build output.
`npm run typecheck` and `npm run build` pass with zero errors.
verification: cd c:\website\GrooveSystem && npm run typecheck  # zero TS errors
cd c:\website\GrooveSystem && npm run build  # zero build errors
cd c:\website\GrooveSystem && npm run logos:sync  # runs, prints summary; fallbacks OK if no network/creds — record actual results
Confirm vercel.json has both cron entries (dance-agent unchanged + new dance-logos weekly).
Confirm LOGO_SOURCES.md and report.md exist and every org has a row; no unverified logo is marked verified.
